title: A word counter for the command line

cases.name: extra spaces and a blank line
a missing file: exit code 1 and nothing on stdout
no argument: exit code 2 and nothing on stdout

hints: The real arguments start at process.argv[2].
readFileSync(file, "utf8") gives the text. Wrap it in try/catch for the missing file.
Lines: count the "\n" characters. Words: text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length. Characters: text.length.
console.error for messages, then process.exit(1) or process.exit(2).
